lines.en: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
lines.cn: 先听这段录音，然后再回答这个问题。

lines.en: Which car was the winner in 1995?
lines.cn: 哪辆车在1995年赢得了比赛？

lines.en: There is a car race near our town every year.
lines.cn: 每年我们镇附近都会举行一场汽车比赛。

lines.en: In 1995, there was a very big race.
lines.cn: 1995年，有一场规模非常大的比赛。

lines.en: There were hundreds of people there.
My wife and I were at the race.
lines.cn: 我和我的妻子一起去了那场比赛。

lines.en: Our friends Julie and Jack were there, too.
lines.cn: 我们的朋友朱莉和杰克也都在那里。

lines.en: You can see us in the crowd.
lines.cn: 你们可以在人群中看到我们。

lines.en: We are standing on the left.
There were twenty cars in the race.
lines.cn: 比赛中共有二十辆汽车参与角逐。

lines.en: There were English cars, French cars, German cars, Italian cars, American cars and Japanese cars.
lines.cn: 有英国汽车、法国汽车、德国汽车、意大利汽车、美国汽车和日本汽车。
这是个令人兴奋的结局。
获胜者是比利·斯图尔特。

lines.en: He was in car number fifteen.
lines.cn: 他坐在第十五号的车里。

lines.en: Five other cars were just behind him.
lines.cn: 还有另外五辆车紧跟在他后面。

lines.en: On the way home, my wife said to me, 'Don't drive so quickly!
lines.cn: 在回家的路上，我的妻子对我说：‘别开得太快！’
